issues.description: Farm animal collection type/uniqueness requirement is inconsistent: the problem statement explicitly requires storing unique animals using a Set implemented as a HashSet, but the solution declares `private List<Animal> animals` and initializes it with an `ArrayList`, which allows duplicates and contradicts the required data structure and behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent. Preferred: update solution (and template) to `private Set<Animal> animals = new HashSet<>();` (and adjust getter/setter/addAnimal accordingly) to satisfy the uniqueness/HashSet requirement; alternatively, if duplicates are acceptable, remove the Set/HashSet/uniqueness requirement from the problem statement and UML.
